title: Offer to opt window thumbnail tooltips out of "Enable/disable tooltips" setting
line: Task Manager window previews now keep showing when panel and widget tooltips are turned off in System Settings.
explanation: The Task Manager's window previews are built on PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea, which refuses to open anything when plasmarc [PlasmaToolTips] Delay is not positive, i.e. when "Panel and widget tooltips" is unchecked in System Settings. So turning off descriptive tooltips also removed the window previews, which people use to pick windows. libplasma's ToolTipArea gains an ignoreGlobalSetting property (default false; uses the default 700 ms delay when the setting is off), and the Task Manager sets it only while it shows the window preview delegate.

commits.message:
tooltiparea: allow tooltips to ignore the global tooltip setting

Turning off panel and widget tooltips in System Settings also hid any
tooltip that is not just descriptive text, like window previews. Add an
ignoreGlobalSetting property so these can keep showing when hovered.

BUG: 468223

applets/taskmanager: show window previews even with tooltips turned off

Turning off panel and widget tooltips in System Settings also hid the
Task Manager's window previews, which are not just tooltips. Keep them
showing; text tooltips and the "Show previews" option are unaffected.

BUG: 468223

From 6d9ac13dde479edf588cee67732a0dd67f05bdd3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 22:32:14 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: show window previews even with tooltips
 turned off

Turning off panel and widget tooltips in System Settings also hid the
Task Manager's window previews, which are not just tooltips. Keep them
showing; text tooltips and the "Show previews" option are unaffected.

BUG: 468223
---
 applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
index 90530078c5..bb864f20d5 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
@@ -84,6 +84,7 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
     hideOnClick: !(hasAudioStream && audioIndicatorsEnabled)
     location: Plasmoid.location
     mainItem: !Plasmoid.configuration.showToolTips || !model.IsWindow ? pinnedAppToolTipDelegate : openWindowToolTipDelegate
+    ignoreGlobalSetting: mainItem === openWindowToolTipDelegate
 
     onXChanged: {
         if (!completed) {
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Panel and widget tooltips turned off: hovering the Dolphin task shows nothing
Same setting: hovering the Dolphin task shows its window preview

reviews.text: Clean, well-layered solution adding ToolTipArea.ignoreGlobalSetting (\since 6.9) in libplasma with a safe fallback to the default 700 ms delay when the global Delay entry is non-positive, and enabling it in Task.qml only for window previews. Letting Task Manager's existing 'Show small window previews when hovering over tasks' option govern previews independently of the global panel/widget tooltips toggle is the right UX decision without adding settings clutter. Verification and autotests cover both the fix and regressions.
